171999708.title: File:Nubank App Area Pix Dec 2023 – with numbers for explanation.jpg

ImageDescription.value: Pix Area within the Nubank app with numbers for explanation

This paper aims to explain the Brazilian Central Bank’s (BCB) decision to create and operate a new instant payment system: PIX. Understanding that “digital financialization” can take different forms, this study sheds light on the factors that led to the BCB’s choice to launch a “state-owned Fintech”. The analysis considers three complementary factors. Firstly, the BCB’s institutional trajectory has made it protective of its perimeter of power. Secondly, the ideas shared by transnational networks support the active role of central banks in managing instant payment issues. Thirdly, the interests of traditional banks were not significantly impacted to the extent that they would oppose the creation of PIX. Through examining BCB documents and secondary literature, this study provides a first-hand account of the motivations and circumstances that led to the creation of PIX in Brazil.

184596214.title: File:Soap from repurposed cooking oil being sold on streetmarket in São Paulo, Brazil, 19-02-2026.jpg

ImageDescription.value: Soap from repurposed cooking oil being sold on a streetmarket in Bom Retiro neighborhood, São Paulo, Brazil. The sign says Home-made soap; 6,00 Reais; We Collect [Cooking] Oil; Pix [no pixeled]

Brazilian meme based on actual online scams that would make use of pictures similar to this one to illicitly receive money via Pix-powered transfers, promising to send the victim a tenfold higher value in return. On the image there is a "Tabela Trading" (exchange table) that shows how much one would earn (righthand side) given a corresponding sum transferred to the scammer (lefthand side). The checkmarked text on the bottom-left corner reads "Seguro / Prático / Rápido" (Safe / Handy / Fast).
Strawberries for sale in Viçosa MG Brazil. The sign informs that three boxes of strawberry cost 12 reais, and that the salesperson accepts the Pix payment system.
